evidence.quote: THI charges tuition fees of 800 euros per semester (for Bachelor’s programmes).

notes: Teaching-language fact: the DAAD page states that some electives are taught in German, but the programme is English-taught. Tuition fact: the programme page states 800 EUR per semester for Bachelor's programmes; the general third-country tuition page states the same 800 EUR per year, so the tuition value is recorded per semester. Intake deadline fact: the programme page gives a dated deadline (15 July 2027) for the winter semester 2027/28, but does not specify that it is for non-EU applicants, so it is recorded as stated on the programme page. Application channel: the pages state that applicants with a foreign qualification must first obtain a preliminary assessment (VPD) from uni-assist before applying to THI, hence de-uni-assist-vpd; the quotes also mention that a VPD from uni-assist is required for a Bachelor-check at THI. Requirement prior_study_years_min: no page states a minimum number of school years for this programme, so the rule is omitted; the quote used above only addresses applicants whose university entrance qualification was obtained in Germany and does not state a year count. Document list: no page states a specific document list for this programme, so the documents fact is left out.

note.fr: Un entretien de sélection en ligne est requis; les candidats ayant un score de 70 points ou plus y sont invités. Les entretiens ont lieu de mi-juin à fin juillet 2026.
note.en: An online selection interview is required; applicants with a total score of 70 points or more are invited. Interviews take place from mid-June to end of July 2026.

evidence.quote: Applicants who have achieved a total score of 70 points or more will be invited to a short online selection interview.
